concept.location: new civic library concrete entrance vestibule
concept.moment: waiting at the beginning of an architecture tour
concept.light: soft late-morning skylight crossed by a narrow side window beam
concept.pose: frontal stance with one foot slightly forward and gaze toward the camera

reference.subject_adulthood: explicitly adult generation choice, not reference-age inference

success_policy: Every predeclared keyword gate and every adopted profile hard gate must PASS from native pixels; PARTIAL counts as overall failure. Prompt/runtime pass is reported separately; user acceptance remains pending. Exactly one first generation, preserved even when unattractive or defective.

keyword_gates.pass_condition: PASS only if curving stitched seam lines on the dress connect armhole/upper bodice across bust to fitted waist; owner and garment continuity must be visible.
keyword_gates.confusion_boundary: Flat printed lines, piping alone, or short isolated darts.
keyword_gates.prompt_evidence: curved princess seams running from the armholes across the bust into the fitted waist

keyword_gates.pass_condition: PASS only if the upper dress edge forms two rounded lobes with a visible dip at center, continuously attached to this bodice.
keyword_gates.confusion_boundary: V neck, scoop neck, separate necklace arcs, or hidden center dip.
keyword_gates.prompt_evidence: a sweetheart neckline with two rounded lobes and a distinct center dip

keyword_gates.pass_condition: PASS only if both worn sleeves show distinctly fuller shoulders and upper arms, tapering into fitted elbow-to-wrist portions.
keyword_gates.confusion_boundary: Uniform balloon sleeves, elbow puffs, detached volume, or sleeves fully loose to the cuff.
keyword_gates.prompt_evidence: long gigot sleeves with generous shoulder-and-upper-arm volume tapering closely from the elbows to the wrists

keyword_gates.pass_condition: PASS only if at least one hip pocket has an opening visibly framed by slim fabric welt lips and belongs to the dress; both requested pocket sites remain visible for coverage.
keyword_gates.confusion_boundary: Patch pocket, flap pocket, seam decoration, or hands/arms concealing the opening.
keyword_gates.prompt_evidence: Each hip welt pocket is a narrow horizontal opening framed by two slim fabric lips

keyword_gates.pass_condition: PASS only if narrow raised cord-like ivory edging follows the sweetheart boundary and cuff boundaries, physically joined to the dress.
keyword_gates.confusion_boundary: Flat paint, broad binding, seam lines mistaken for cord, or disconnected trim.
keyword_gates.prompt_evidence: Narrow raised ivory piping follows the sweetheart edge and both cuffs

keyword_gates.pass_condition: PASS only if two front-skirt folds face inward and meet toward the center with a recessed fold/depth between or beneath; the inward relation must be pixel-legible.
keyword_gates.confusion_boundary: Outward box pleat, flat slit, simple seam, gathered skirt, or ambiguous fold direction.
keyword_gates.prompt_evidence: An inverted box pleat at the center front of the skirt has two inward-facing folded edges meeting at the center

keyword_gates.pass_condition: PASS only if chain passes through a separately visible open loop joined to the pendant so the support connection is readable.
keyword_gates.confusion_boundary: Chain terminating at pendant, decorative circle with no passage, suspended disconnected pendant, or hidden attachment.
keyword_gates.prompt_evidence: a silver necklace chain passes visibly through the open oval pendant bail, which joins and supports a small rectangular pendant

keyword_gates.pass_condition: PASS only if at least one shoe upper visibly has open lacing with eyelet-bearing quarters layered over the vamp and open edges around its tongue; both shoes must remain in frame.
keyword_gates.confusion_boundary: Oxford closed lacing, featureless black shoes, purely toe silhouettes, or hidden quarter-vamp relation.
keyword_gates.prompt_evidence: Black leather Derby shoes have open lacing: separate eyelet-bearing quarters sit on top of each vamp, their loose edges opening into a clear V around the tongues

additional_gates.pass_condition: All eight chosen constructions belong to the one wearer and are visible simultaneously in the same photograph.
Body-part ownership, arm/leg continuity, standing floor contact, and garment/jewelry attachment remain anatomically and spatially coherent.
Visible short dark bob with fine fringe and face appearance are used without transferring portrait wardrobe or asserting identity.
